comment: Ratcheting line-coverage floor for the CTOC test-gate (src/scripts/test-gate.js). The gate fails when measured suite coverage drops below minPct. This is a RATCHET like .ctoc/typecheck-baseline.json: it may only ever be RAISED as coverage improves — NEVER lowered to make a failing run pass. New code is held to >= 80% at review (Iron Loop Step 14).
notes: Raised 40 -> 88 after fixing the gate's MEASUREMENT (v6.12.14). The old 40 recorded a broken metric: test-gate ran node --experimental-test-coverage over the 277-file test glob WITHOUT --test-coverage-include=src/**, so the aggregate denominator was inflated ~6x and read ~40% while real src line coverage was ~91%. The gate now scopes coverage to src/** and measures 91.18% line (node, scoped) / 88.5% (line-weighted hand-check). Floor set to 88 — just under the measured truth so coverage cannot silently regress, with ~3 points of headroom for cross-platform/run variance. Human-approved raise (Tijn, 2026-07-14). Never lower to make a run pass; fix the tests or the code.
